knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic payment snapshot
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional payments with rails, amounts, originators, beneficiaries, stages, and risk signals for one value date.

knowledge.name: Scheme and repair rules
knowledge.detail: Rail limits, carried currencies, account and reference checks, and a repair playbook keyed by failure code.

knowledge.name: Settlement and KPI records
knowledge.detail: One fictional settlement account with four breaks and prior-day volume and exception counts by rail.

intelligence_processing.name: Scheme-rule validation
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks amount limit, currency, beneficiary account, and reference uniqueness and returns failure codes.

intelligence_processing.name: Exception repair planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Maps failure codes to repair steps, eligible re-route rails, priority, and a draft originator note.

intelligence_processing.name: Pre-release risk scoring
intelligence_processing.detail: Scores amount versus average, new beneficiary, out-of-hours, and high value with screening context.

intelligence_processing.name: Settlement break ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes match rate, net and gross break value, and the largest break to work first.

intelligence_processing.name: Straight-through rate rollup
intelligence_processing.detail: Computes per-rail and total straight-through rate and the weakest rail from volumes and exceptions.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with seven skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing is gated.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Teams access
clients_user_interface.detail: Release-desk entry point for analysts and leads once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file PaymentsOperationsAgent locally with deterministic synthetic routing.

management_reporting.name: Release queue view
management_reporting.detail: Payments by stage, queue value, and the payments that need attention today.

management_reporting.name: Daily KPI brief
management_reporting.detail: Volume, exceptions, and straight-through rate by rail with today's open items.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Seven locked persona cases, transcripts, and the separate publish approval gate.

tools.name: Portable PaymentsOperationsAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with seven deterministic read-only operations over synthetic data.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the seven-skill package in Draft; publishing needs explicit approval.

tools.name: Power Automate agent flow
tools.detail: Materialized flow that returns the agent's exact outputs for each operation.

tools.name: Approved payments hub
tools.detail: Cited production seam for payments and stages; no live connection in the package.

tools.name: Authorized analyst workflow
tools.detail: Cited human workflow for release, hold, repair, and posting decisions.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional payments and forbids browsing, live-system claims, or invented values.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never releases, holds, repairs, resubmits, posts, or messages anyone.

supporting_features.name: Analyst decision gate
supporting_features.detail: Every release, hold, re-route, and adjustment stays with an authorized analyst.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Seven natural-language cases verify one operation each with exact evidence anchors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publication control
supporting_features.detail: The Copilot Studio package stays Draft until an authorized publish decision.
